Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc

Schnittstelle NpcVisibilityRule

Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface NpcVisibilityRule
An extra condition on whether a player may see an NPC.

Registered through NpcManager.registerVisibilityRule(NpcVisibilityRule) and consulted by the tracker after the built-in distance and permission checks in NpcVisibility have passed. Every registered rule must agree before the NPC is shown; a single rule returning false hides it.

This is the hook for everything the core deliberately does not know about — regions, parties, quest progress, instance ownership, vanish plugins.

Performance

A rule is called for every candidate pairing of a nearby player and NPC, several times a second. On a server with a thousand NPCs that is a lot of calls, so an implementation must be a cheap in-memory lookup. A rule that queries a database, walks a region tree or allocates per call will show up in the server's tick time; cache the answer and invalidate it on the event that changes it, then call Npc.refreshVisibility() so the tracker re-evaluates.

Rules are called on the main server thread.
